title: See disk usage and clean up data on this machine
what: Shows how much the app takes on this machine (a bar split by part: Database, AI sessions, Downloaded tag photos, AI run history, Server log, Telegram sign-in, Configuration), the database by table and by group. Clear one part at a time: handled messages older than 30 days, Briefing summaries, the old send log, finished AI sessions, downloaded photos, AI run history, the server log, one group's data, the Documents library (downloaded Knowledge Base articles, the index and summaries; a sync fetches them again), reply drafts in this browser. Each clear asks first and says what is lost and what is kept; the database is compacted afterwards. On startup the app removes photos older than 30 days, AI runs older than 90 days and trims a log over 5 MB. The "Change folder" button (bottom of the Disk usage card, next to the path) moves all the data to another folder: type an absolute path, the app restarts, switches to the new place only once the move is done, then deletes the old copy; on failure it keeps using the old folder. If that folder already holds Radar data (a disk used with another install), the dialog asks "Use the data there": the app switches to that data and the data in use stays where it was, not deleted. Not available while the AI Agent is running; cloud-synced folders (iCloud, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive) are refused because they corrupt the database. If the new folder is on an external disk, the disk must be plugged in when the app opens.
how: Look at the "Disk usage" card: the total, what can be cleared now, and the split by part

how.t: Click "Clear" on the tile to clean up; each tile shows its size, item count, since when, and whether it comes back
Read the confirmation; click "Cancel" to leave (only click "Clear" if you really want to)

title: Report a bug or request a feature from the developer
what: Send a bug, a feature request, a suggestion or a question to the developer: click a type tile, pick the area (each type says what to write), write a title (up to 120 characters) and a description (up to 3000 characters; the description box fills the screen and scrolls); a ring by each field's name counts the characters, amber near the limit and red at it. Attach up to 5 images (image button, paste ⌘V or drag into the description; big ones are shrunk). "Machine info" (on by default) adds the version, OS, browser and Telegram / YouTrack state; "Error log" (Bug only) attaches the app's warnings / errors from the last 24 hours as log.txt. Click "Preview" (⌘Enter) to see the exact Telegram message, then "Send" (⌘Enter). On an unexpected error, the error toast has "Report it", which opens this section with the error code and the current screen filled in. On an old version, it reminds you to update first. The "AI" chip in the composer rewrites the title and description clearly (steps, result, expected; anything missing becomes "(chưa rõ)" for you to fill in), streaming into the box with a stop button; a toast then offers "Undo".

title: Draw a State workflow for your role
what: The State flow for the chosen project and role: boxes are States, arrows the allowed next steps. The workflow always applies: the State menu, Board drag and drop and bulk changes only follow the arrows (YouTrack still checks its own flow); a role with no arrow yet cannot change any State, and a ticket's State menu, the bulk State menu and the top of the Board show a "Draw the workflow" line that leads here. The toolbar: "Get from YouTrack" copies the flow YouTrack allows today (the quickest start), plus Auto-arrange and Delete all arrows. The diagram on the left holds the States in use, the column on the right the rest: drag a State from the column onto the diagram (or click it) to add it, drag a box from the diagram onto the column to take it off. Drag a box to move it, drag its dot onto another box to connect; click a box and its arrows and the States they link stand out while the rest fades (click an empty spot or press Esc to let go); click a box or an arrow (or Tab to it) then Delete, or the × that shows on it, to remove it. By keyboard: Tab to a box, Enter, Tab to the target box and Enter to draw an arrow. Every edit is a draft: an "Unsaved draft" strip opens under the diagram with Discard draft and Save; moving between Settings groups keeps the draft, closing Settings drops it. Dev starts with a default flow when the project has its states; QA/QC and PO/PM start empty.

how.t: Click "Get from YouTrack" (or drag a box's dot onto another to draw an arrow)
